_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values so extracted.

hours_low.basis: low end of the developers' 18 to 24 hour comparison

hours_low_minutes.basis: hours_low * 60, drawn only as a length on a time scale

homes.basis: more than this many damaged homes in the training imagery, a floor

disasters.basis: major disasters in the training imagery

buildings.basis: roughly this many buildings per finished orthomosaic

minutes.basis: about this many minutes per finished orthomosaic

season_year.basis: the hurricane season of the Florida and Pennsylvania deployments
